text: National anthem over, 90,000 at the MCG! Shaheen to KL Rahul!
Shaheen Afridi swinging it both ways! Pehli ball se pressure!
KL Rahul off the mark with a quick single.
Unplayable inswing from Shaheen! Rohit beaten!
Rohit opens his account with 2 runs off the pads.
5 runs off Shaheen's first over. Pakistan looking sharp in the field.
Naseem Shah starts over 2! Raw pace on display!
Score is 7/0. Both openers taking it cautiously.
Naseem extracting sharp bounce outside off stump!
BOWLED HIMMM!! NASEEM SHAH BREAKS THROUGH! KL RAHUL DRAGGED ON! 7/1! 🚨
KING KOHLI WALKS IN! What an atmosphere at the MCG! 👑
Shaheen vs Rohit again! MCG roaring!
Kohli off the mark with soft hands into the off side.
10/1 after 3 overs. Run rate is under 4, need to survive Shaheen.
Haris Rauf into the attack at 148 kph!
EDGED AND TAKEN! HARIS GETS ROHIT SHARMA! Iftikhar at slip! INDIA 10/2! 😱
SURYAKUMAR YADAV FIRST BALL BOUNDARY! Steers through point for FOUR! 4️⃣
17/2 after 4 overs. SKY not holding back!
WHAT A LOFTED PUNCH BY SKY! Four over mid-on! 23/2!
Naseem gives only 7. 24/2 after 5 overs.
SKY glides past third man for FOUR! Class batting!
HARIS GETS SURYAKUMAR YADAV! Massive outside edge caught behind! INDIA 31/3!
Axar Patel promoted to #5! Powerplay is over.
DISASTER FOR INDIA! AXAR PATEL RUN OUT! Catastrophic mix-up with Kohli! 31/4! 🤯
Hardik Pandya walks out. India 31/4 in 7 overs. Can they rescue this?
35/4 after 7 overs. Shadab bowling tight spin.
Kohli and Hardik running like gazelles between the wickets.
41/4 after 8 overs. Required rate crossing 10 rpo.
45/4 after 9 overs. Pakistan controlling the game completely.
Halfway stage: 50/4 in 10 overs. India need 110 runs in 60 balls!
55/4 after 11 overs. Required rate is 11.66 rpo.
BOOM! HARDIK PANDYA SMASHES NAWAZ DOWNTOWN FOR SIX! 💥 First maximum!
11 runs off Nawaz's over! 66/4 after 12. Counter-attack has started!
KING KOHLI ROCKS BACK AND PULLS SHADAB FOR FOUR! 👑 70/4!
74/4 after 13 overs. 86 needed off 42 balls.
Hardik slices Haris Rauf for FOUR through third man! Crucial boundary!
86/4 after 14 overs! Kohli & Hardik 50+ stand! 74 needed off 36 balls!
CRACKING SHOT! Kohli stands tall and punches Naseem through cover for FOUR!
10 off Naseem's over! 96/4! 64 needed off 30 balls!
Century up for India! 100/4! Partnership is now 69 runs!
GLORIOUS VIRAT! Whips Shaheen through midwicket for FOUR! 106/4!
54 needed off 24 balls. Match on a razor's edge!
HUGE LBW APPEAL on Kohli! Umpire says NOT OUT! Babar doesn't take DRS!
HARDIK DISPATCHES NASEEM! 85 METERS INTO THE MIDWICKET STANDS! SIX! 🚀
115/4 after 17 overs! 45 needed off 18 balls! Pulse racing!
KOHLI SHUFFLES AND CHIPS SHAHEEN OVER EXTRA COVER FOR FOUR! Masterclass!
ANOTHER FOUR! Hooked fiercely in front of square! 124/4!
CATCH CHHOD DIYA!! Shan Masood drops Kohli at deep cover! What have you done?! 😱😭
129/4 after 18 overs! 31 needed off 12 balls! Haris Rauf bowling next!
Haris 149 kph dot ball! 28 needed off 8 balls! Impossible chase lag raha hai!
SHOT OF AN EMPEROR!! STRAIGHT BACK OVER HARIS RAUF HEAD FOR SIX!! 🤯🔥👑
HE'S DONE IT AGAIN! FLICKED OVER FINE LEG FOR SIX! 16 NEEDED OFF 6 BALLS!
WICKET! Hardik miscues, caught by Babar! 16 needed off 5 balls!
2 runs taken! 13 needed off 3 balls! Kohli on strike!
NO BALL + SIXXXX! WAIST HIGH FULL TOSS! FREE HIT COMING UP! 🚨🎉
DK STUMPED! 2 NEEDED OFF 1 BALL! ASHWIN WALKS IN!
Ashwin left the wide, then CHIPS OVER MID-OFF! INDIA WINS AT THE MCG! 🏆🇮🇳🎉
